verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is an online government e-services portal, so AI-generated insights or suggestions are a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains only HTTP probes of the front door and a retired entry path, and neither says anything about AI features, so the applicable capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
